Year from the BMS press release (Dec 2019, 'Liso-Cel Met Primary and Secondary Endpoints in TRANSCEND NHL 001', ORR 73% of 256). efficacy.quote: Of 256 patients included in the efficacy-evaluable set, an objective response was achieved by 186 (73%, 95% CI 66·8-78·0) patients and a complete response by 136 (53%, 46·8-59·4).

safety.confidence_note: Abstract read (PMID 20668228). Imported: no LBCL patient safety data existed in 2010. CBER Yescarta review (fda.gov/media/109149, 2017) then measured LBCL: 'Grade 1 or 2 hypogammaglobulinemia occurred in 16/108 (15%) subjects', same direction. Mouse silence on CRS and neurotoxicity not scored as a miss.
safety.judgement: On-target harm predicted and seen. The mice 'did not show any overt signs of toxicity', but per the brief a mouse cannot show cytokine release; ICANS treated the same way as it arises from the same cytokine/endothelial cascade. Review places both findings in one memo but does not compare them, so comparison_stated false.
safety.note: Earliest date (rule 6): the predicted B-cell loss and hypogammaglobulinaemia appeared in the first FMC63-28Z patient (follicular lymphoma; no LBCL data yet). LBCL patients agreed in 2017 (15% hypogammaglobulinaemia).
